datasets.name: Quad-pol ALOS-2 SAR data
datasets.verbatim: ALOS-2 is an L-band radar system and collects in the Stripmap (SM) imaging mode, having HH, HV, VH and VV polarimetric channels.

datasets.name: Dual-pol Sentinel-1 SAR data
datasets.verbatim: Sentinel-1 is a satellite-borne C-band radar system and the single look complex (SLC) format data of the VH, VV polarization channels in the Interferometric Wide (IW) mode are used for this experiment.

datasets.name: 3-D view of the Shenzhen landslide
datasets.source: State Bureau of Surveying and Mapping, China
datasets.verbatim: 3-D view of the Shenzhen landslide on December 21, 2015, provided by the State Bureau of Surveying and Mapping, China.

datasets.name: Google Earth optical images
datasets.verbatim: In Fig. 7, the red curve represents the landslide boundary identified using the proposed method based on quad-pol ALOS-2 data, while the blue curve represents the boundary determined through manual visualization of the corresponding Google Earth optical images.

methods.name: Deep learning method exploiting a morphological model (DLM)
methods.summary: A landslide mapping framework that uses a single post-event polarimetric SAR image. It employs a Deep Forest (DF) algorithm for initial identification, a Majority Voting mechanism to refine the shape using polarimetric decomposition results, and a morphological optimization model based on aspect ratio and longitudinal shape to extract the final landslide boundary.
methods.verbatim: In this study, we propose a deep learning method which exploits a morphological model (DLM) to achieve accurate landslide identification using only a post-event single-temporal polarimetric SAR image.

availability.author_statement: Data will be made available on request.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory and other input datasets are not linked or provided, and the custom DLM method code is not available via any repository or persistent link.
